title: Cache crashed and stayed down
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the crashed Redis cache as the cause of the login/cart failures.
root_cause: The Redis cache container (redis:7.4) crashed with a segmentation fault (signal 11) 25 minutes ago, causing the API to lose its session/store connection and return 500 errors for login and cart operations.
truth: Redis crashed once on a rare bug (signal 11, segmentation fault). The container has no restart policy, so it stayed down, and login and cart, which keep sessions in Redis, fail.
